commands: sudo -H -u ubuntu bash -lc 'export HOME=/home/ubuntu; export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; openclaw plugins list 2>/dev/null' || echo 'openclaw not in path'

sudo -H -u ubuntu XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000 bash -lc 'export HOME=/home/ubuntu; export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; openclaw channels list 2>/dev/null || openclaw channel list 2>/dev/null || echo no-channels-cmd'
